text.tspan: National poverty line vs. GDP per capita
The horizontal line indicates the International Poverty Line, set by the World Bank to be representative of
national definitions of poverty adopted by low-income countries.
GDP per capita (international-$ in 2021 prices; plotted on a logarithmic axis)
Harmonized national poverty line (international-$ in 2021 prices; plotted on a logarithmic axis)
Data source: Foster et al. (2025); Eurostat, OECD, IMF, and World Bank (2026)
Note: This data is expressed in international-$ at 2021 prices to account for inflation and differences in living costs between countries. Where
data for 2023 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 1993 and 2053 is shown instead.
